discipline_risks.risk_domains: Code, data handling, web security, automation and deployment.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Sandbox accounts, synthetic data, least privilege, secure defaults; test edge cases; do not expose customer data.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult/qualified review for public deployment, real user data or security testing.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No credential collection, unauthorized access, malware, exploit deployment or public deployment with unresolved data risks.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Pricing, sales, customer interviews, payments, contracts and financial projections.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Use mock transactions; guardian-approved channels; truthful claims; protect customer data; distinguish education from legal/tax advice.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Guardian review for real transactions, contracts, customer data, payment accounts or public offers.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No borrowing, leveraged trading, investment solicitation or handling other people’s money without guardian and qualified advice.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Circuits, soldering, batteries, motors, tools and electrical measurements.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Only documented extra-low-voltage battery circuits for independent practice; inspect heat/shorts; tool-specific instruction.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Competent adult supervision for soldering, cutting, drilling, high-current batteries or powered tools; professional for mains.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No mains electricity, high-voltage capacitors, damaged lithium cells, improvised chargers, puncturing cells or unsupervised power tools.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Saving, budgeting, payments, investing, crypto, tax and financial decisions.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Hypothetical examples by default; disclose risk/fees; use regulated local sources; guardian-controlled real accounts.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Guardian review for any real money/account/transfer/contract; qualified financial/tax professional for personal decisions.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No leverage, borrowing, gambling-like trading, crypto custody for others or using another person’s account.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Anatomy, physiology, health claims, nutrition, sleep, injury and body metrics.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Non-diagnostic educational framing; avoid body-shaming; no personalised treatment/diet/supplement prescriptions; include referral boundaries.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Guardian involvement for minors; clinician/physio/dietitian for injury, persistent symptoms or personalised plans.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No diagnosis, extreme dieting, supplement experimentation or ignoring concerning symptoms.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Psychology, strategy, self-reflection, motivation, interpersonal behaviour and sensitive topics.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Educational not diagnostic; avoid manipulation and trait labels; use supportive language; do not solicit trauma disclosures.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Guardian/qualified support for persistent distress, abuse disclosures or mental-health concerns.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No diagnosis, therapy claims, coercive experiments, personality ranking or investigation of abuse by AI.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Visual design, perception, aesthetics, visual communication and public display.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Use non-identifying sample assets; credit sources; check colour contrast and avoid culturally loaded assumptions.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult review for public portfolio display or use of identifiable people.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No non-consensual portrait use, doxxing through location clues or unlicensed commercial reuse.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Workflow, productivity, routines, schedules, notifications and personal records.
discipline_risks.required_controls: User-controlled suggestions; no silent rescheduling; local-first records; sleep/recovery protection; visible undo and history.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Guardian involvement for sharing location/schedule or commitments involving other people.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No surveillance, public schedule sharing by default, punitive streaks, backlog debt or coercive productivity scoring.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Drawing, craft, materials, blades, pigments, photography and exhibition.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Age-safe materials; tool instruction; ventilation; consent for portraits; source/licence records.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult supervision for blades, solvents, heat tools or public exhibition involving minors.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No hazardous solvents, unsafe cutting tools, non-consensual photography or unlicensed commercial reuse.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Sports drills, conditioning, competition, contact, heat and outdoor activity.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Progress gradually; warm up; hydration/rest; inspect surface/weather; default to non-contact; do not train through pain.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Guardian/coach supervision for organised training, contact drills, strength equipment, heat exposure or unfamiliar venues.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No dangerous stunts, deliberate head impacts, dehydration/weight-cutting, unsupervised heavy lifting or play in unsafe conditions.
discipline_risks.qualified_review_required: Qualified youth coach; sports medicine/physio reviewer

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Voice, music, performance, hearing exposure, recording and public presentation.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Safe volume, warm-up/rest, recording consent, copyright and accessible alternatives.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult supervision for amplified equipment, high volume or public performance/recording involving minors.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No prolonged high-volume exposure or non-consensual publication of recordings.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Mathematics, scientific reasoning, statistics, models and experiments.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Teach units, assumptions, uncertainty, sample bias and correlation/causation; physical experiments require separate activity risk overlay.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult/qualified supervision for physical experiments, hazardous materials or sensitive datasets.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No hazardous experiments, unsafe field sampling or consequential inference about people from biased/small datasets.
discipline_risks.qualified_review_required: Math/statistics/science reviewer; lab safety reviewer where relevant

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Account security, networks, penetration testing, digital privacy and incident response.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Owned lab systems, local VMs, synthetic data, explicit written scope; never store credentials or tokens.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Qualified review for labs; guardian involvement for real account incidents or reports.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No credential theft, phishing deployment, malware, persistence, evasion or unauthorised public-target testing.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Language learning, translation, dialects, voice and identity-linked examples.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Respect dialects; mark translation uncertainty; do not publish identifiable recordings; allow text alternatives when pronunciation is not target.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Consent and guardian review before recording/sharing a minor’s voice or image.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No public posting of identifying recordings or sensitive personal stories without appropriate consent.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Research, surveys, interviews, source evaluation, human subjects and personal data.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Prefer open data; consent; minimise and anonymise; explain sampling bias; distinguish fact/inference/opinion.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Guardian/teacher approval before surveying/interviewing minors or collecting identifiable data.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No covert recording, sensitive-data collection or publication of identifiable responses without approval.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Cooking, repairs, household tools, travel, public services and independent tasks.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Teach hazard checks, food hygiene, permission, safe lifting, route planning and adult escalation; no risky repair instructions.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult supervision for knives, heat, gas, electrical repair, unfamiliar travel or public-facing tasks.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No gas/electrical repair, unsafe road crossings, entering restricted spaces, handling unknown chemicals or unsupervised fire.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Team leadership, project coordination, group decisions and responsibility.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Use opt-in roles, fair workload, transparent decisions, conflict escalation and private feedback.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult oversight for public events, money, travel or disputes involving minors.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No coercion, hazing, retaliation, public ranking/shaming or pressure to disclose private information.

discipline_risks.risk_domains: Public speaking, persuasion, interviews, conflict and online interaction.
discipline_risks.required_controls: Teach consent, respectful disagreement, truthful representation and boundaries; anonymise roleplay recordings.
discipline_risks.supervision_rule: Adult support for threats, harassment, abuse or power imbalance.
discipline_risks.prohibited_or_stop_conditions: No coercive persuasion, impersonation, public shaming or unsafe contact with strangers.

cross_cutting_controls.rule: Assume a learner may be under 18 unless age is explicitly established. Match instructions, tools, exposure and public interaction to age, maturity, setting and demonstrated competence; do not infer legal capacity.

Every physical, health, electrical, chemical, field or first-aid activity must state stop conditions before the activity. If danger, pain, distress or uncertainty appears, stop and involve a responsible adult or qualified professional.
Course completion, a quiz, simulation or ATHENA mastery state never substitutes for a licence, regulated qualification, medical diagnosis, first-aid certification or professional competence.

For minors, guardian/teacher/coach involvement is required for real money, contracts, public publication, contact with unknown adults, physical hazards, fieldwork and collection of identifiable human-subject data.
In a real emergency, stop the lesson and seek immediate local emergency assistance. The app must not interpose a quiz, AI conversation or long disclaimer before the emergency action.

Obtain informed, specific, revocable permission before capturing or sharing a person’s image, voice, name, location, work or story. For minors, apply guardian consent and child assent; do not treat assent as a substitute for required guardian approval.

Collect only what is necessary for the stated learning function. Prefer local storage, synthetic or anonymised data; avoid exact location, government IDs, passwords, biometrics, health details and sensitive identity attributes.
Learner evidence, portfolios, recordings, schedules and reflections are private by default. Sharing requires a deliberate per-item action, audience preview and clear withdrawal path.

cross_cutting_controls.control: No AI authority in high-risk domains
cross_cutting_controls.rule: AI output may assist explanation but cannot independently approve safety, diagnose, certify, adjudicate safeguarding disclosures or make consequential financial/health decisions.

Provide a clear route to stop, preserve only necessary facts, contact a trusted adult/appropriate authority and escalate imminent danger. Do not investigate alleged abuse through the app or promise absolute confidentiality.
Do not reward pain tolerance, sleep restriction, overtraining, risky stunts, public exposure, financial risk-taking or invasive data collection as productivity or mastery.

Jurisdiction-specific law, emergency numbers and regulated guidance require a named source, last-verified date, owner and expiry/recheck date. Unverified legal claims must be withheld or labelled pending review.

activity_overlays.activity: First aid / CPR / AED / choking / severe bleeding
activity_overlays.rule: Awareness and emergency escalation only until recognised first-aid instructor and medical reviewer approve exact current local protocol. Never delay emergency services. Reading is not competence or certification.

Simulation or safe observation by default. Any physical activity requires activity-specific risk assessment and competent adult/lab supervision. No unknown mixing, ingestion, culturing unknown organisms or improvised pressure/heat apparatus.

activity_overlays.activity: Public field activity / road / water / weather / animals
activity_overlays.rule: Permission, adult supervision, route/weather check and buddy system. No entering floodwater, drains, construction sites, restricted land or handling unknown animals/materials.

activity_overlays.activity: Human-subject work with minors or sensitive topics
activity_overlays.rule: No collection until teacher/guardian/ethics approval, consent/assent, data minimisation, retention plan and safeguarding lead are in place.
Age-appropriate adult supervision for heat, knives, gas and allergens; follow current Bangladesh food safety guidance; do not teach unsafe preservation or tasting of unknown substances.

activity_overlays.activity: Public product launch / real users / payments
activity_overlays.rule: Synthetic data and test payments first; guardian/owner approval; privacy, security, consumer claims, refund and rollback review before real deployment.
